close_reason: CID capability advertised in Session. Upload response already returns sha256 (was implemented since day one). Test verifies urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid is present as empty object per spec.
description: Implement urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid capability per draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00. Extends blob upload response with sha256 field (lowercase hex, 64 chars). Server computes SHA-256 at upload time, returns it unconditionally. When FileNode is also supported, adds sha256 property to FileNode objects (null for directories). Enables client-side integrity verification on upload and download, duplicate detection without downloading, and content-addressed storage patterns.
title: JMAP CID: blob content identifiers
